executiveSnapshot: Watchlist civic letter automation asset; product exists, but demand and deliverability are unproven.
summary: CivicState converts civic issues into researched, cited letters to officials. Repo evidence supports product work, not investibility.
adoptionMechanism: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record
sourcesAndMethods: Workspace-only review; no network research used.
Inspected implementation evidence in apps/api/src, apps/web/app, apps/web/components, apps/worker/src, and packages/shared/prisma/schema.prisma.
Tagged repo-backed claims as [evidence] and external market/legal/customer claims as [assumption: basis].
thesisCurrent: Credible product thesis for done-for-you civic letters; not yet a credible venture thesis without live demand, deliverability, and legal validation.

customerDefinition.primary: US resident with a specific civic issue who would contact government if research, drafting, routing, and delivery were handled [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md].
customerDefinition.excluded: Legal filings, regulatory claims, lobbying firms, law firms, PACs, and enterprise advocacy teams [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md; .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md].

revenueModel.active: One-time Stripe checkout for letter delivery packages [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts].

financialFigures: $6,000 monthly revenue at 400 submissions x $15 AOV [assumption: model in BUSINESS.md]

marketSizing.method: Bottoms-up paid submissions x average order value because no network research was available.
marketSizing.baseCase: 400 monthly paid submissions x $15 AOV = $6,000 monthly revenue [assumption: BUSINESS.md model].
marketSizing.investibilityTest: 5,000 monthly paid submissions x $15 AOV = $75,000 monthly revenue [assumption: BUSINESS.md model; volume band from MASTER_PLAN.md].

competition: Quorum and VoterVoice [assumption: enterprise civic advocacy competitors need external validation]
Generic AI chat plus manual email [assumption: obvious substitute workflow]
goToMarket: SEO-first hypothesis from public campaign pages, validated through narrow pilots before paid acquisition [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md; assumption: channel performance unknown].

risksAntiPlan.killCase: Low ticket size, trust-sensitive workflow, hard government deliverability, and no live demand evidence make this non-investible until validation gates clear.

holes.mitigation: Run small operator-reviewed pilots and measure preview-to-payment conversion.
holes.residualRisk: Users may expect civic action tools to be free.

holes.mitigation: Warm domain, test inbox placement, track bounces and complaints.
holes.residualRisk: Agency domains may still filter repetitive AI-generated mail.

holes.hole: Legal/compliance posture is not externally reviewed.
holes.mitigation: Require counsel/operator review before public launch.
holes.residualRisk: Defamation, harassment, privacy, lobbying, AI disclosure, or CAN-SPAM issues may remain.

holes.mitigation: Align tier keys and run sandbox payment flow.
holes.residualRisk: Payment conversion data is invalid until checkout works.

assumptionLedger: Residents will pay for civic letter delivery [assumption: must validate with live conversion].
SEO can acquire qualified traffic [assumption: must validate with search data].
Official email delivery works reliably [assumption: must validate with inbox/bounce tests].
AI citations can be verified enough for production [assumption: must validate failure rate].
One operator can handle launch exceptions [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md; assumption: queue volume unknown].

honestyLabels.assumption: External market, customer, legal, vendor, or operational claim not verified in workspace-only mode.

freshness.staleRisk: High for external market, legal, vendor pricing, official API coverage, and deliverability claims.

surpriseSpikes: Existing-state says zero application code exists, but repo now has API, web, worker, and Prisma implementation evidence.
Planning roadmap marks all phases complete while requirements still list core pending work.
Frontend pricing tier keys do not match backend payment tier keys.
Registry note frames this as personal/research and not near-term investible unless operator confirms business intent.

roadmapBuildableShape.traceability: Each Now / Next / Later item maps to a BUSINESS.md heading.

operatorValidationNeeded: Confirm whether project should pitch as a business or remain personal/research.
